name: Denmark

laws.cite: Lov nr. 692 af 08/06/2018 om tilgængelighed af offentlige organers websteder og mobilapplikationer
laws.summary: Public bodies' websites and mobile apps must meet the harmonised standard and publish an accessibility statement.

applies_to: Authorities and bodies governed by public law.
requires: Accessibility statement created in Digitaliseringsstyrelsen's WAS-Tool
Feedback link for users to report inaccessible content
mobile: explicit — the law's title covers mobile applications.
enforcement: Digitaliseringsstyrelsen (Agency for Digital Government) monitors and supervises compliance and receives citizen reports.
notes: The law citation comes from a retsinformation.dk search result, which was not opened. The page names 'edit.was.digst.dk' as the tool host; the was.digst.dk root is inferred from it.
